verdict.rationale: gstack's own upgrade skill is gated by an auto-upgrade check (GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE) and distinguishes global from vendored installs, and project-local setup never silently replaces a global install. Together these give some control over when updates land, but the evidence never documents version pinning, a lockfile, or team-wide rollout control. missing for 10: explicit version pinning or a lockfile, documented team-wide control of update rollout, clear docs on what auto-upgrade does by default, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
